name: corky-gmail
description: Codex-facing Gmail adapter that routes auth, thread, draft, and send flows through the local corky CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Use the local corky CLI for Gmail auth checks, draft creation, thread refresh, and send flows.
interface.longDescription: Thin local adapter for Codex Gmail work. It keeps Gmail auth, token storage, threading correctness, and draft/send behavior in corky while providing a repo-local plugin surface with safe wrapper scripts and workflow guidance.
defaultPrompt: Check Gmail auth state through corky.
Refetch a Gmail thread and draft a reply through corky.
Push or send an approved corky draft through Gmail.
